name: Oitsume ~Ryoujoku no Utage~
source:
Main character as well as a number of other participants are thrown into an old abandoned school building. With traps set everywhere, nine people have to compete for food, shelter and trust on their escape survival path. What's the purpose of this madness? Who's the mastermind? What's the fate of the winner and losers?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角和其他几名参与者被丢进一栋废弃的旧校舍。到处都设有陷阱，9个人必须在逃生求生的路上争夺食物、住所和信任。这场疯狂的目的是什么？幕后主使是谁？胜者与败者的命运又将如何？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
